name: Veg Cutlet
steps: Steam diced carrot and peas for 8 minutes until tender, drain and mash coarsely with peeled boiled potato.
Add cumin, garam masala, lemon juice, coriander and salt. For breadcrumb recipes, mix in half the crumbs and reserve the rest for coating.
Mix into a firm dough-like filling. If very soft, chill for 20 minutes; avoid adding water.
Divide into 12 equal portions and shape into patties about 1.5 cm thick. Coat breadcrumb recipes in the reserved crumbs.
Heat a thin layer of oil in a wide skillet over medium heat. Pan-fry in batches for 3–4 minutes per side until crisp and heated through.
Drain briefly and serve three patties per portion. Break the test piece open to check the centre is piping hot.
tips: Cook one test piece first to check seasoning, binding and cooking temperature before finishing the batch.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
